title: وردة غيّرت عمرنا
style: Cinematic Japanese anime feature film, mature high-end 2D animation, richly detailed hand-painted backgrounds, soft realistic lighting, delicate clean line art, expressive eyes, natural hair and cloth motion, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, romantic atmosphere, color palette of rose red, warm gold, cream and calm blue, 16:9 widescreen, 24fps, smooth slow camera movement
negative: deformed face, deformed hands, extra fingers, fused fingers, character design changing between shots, inconsistent outfits, garbled text, distorted Arabic letters, any on-screen text or captions, real social media logos, real usernames, jitter, flicker, robotic motion, exaggerated facial expressions, childish cartoon style, chibi, slapstick, random transitions, heavy black areas, oversaturated dark tones, intimate or suggestive content, extra main characters

characters.BRIDE: a beautiful young Iraqi woman in refined anime style, long dark brown-black hair, soft delicate features, large expressive dark-brown eyes, warm light-olive skin, gentle shy smile, slim, medium height
characters.MOHAMMED: a handsome young Iraqi man named Mohammed in refined anime style, short neat dark-black hair slightly swept to the side, calm attractive features, warm dark-brown eyes, light stubble, tall, relaxed confident posture
characters.FRIEND: a cheerful friendly young woman in refined anime style wearing a hijab, round friendly face, bright smiling eyes

uni.BRIDE: long hair worn loose and flowing, cream knit cardigan over a dusty-rose blouse, long light-beige skirt
uni.MOHAMMED: simple youthful clothes: navy bomber jacket over a white t-shirt, dark jeans
uni.FRIEND: soft lavender hijab, long modest sage-green coat

baghdad.BRIDE: hair loose, long camel wool coat, burgundy scarf around the neck
baghdad.MOHAMMED: elegant charcoal overcoat over a crisp white shirt, dark trousers

tikrit.BRIDE: hair loose, long camel wool coat, burgundy scarf, small travel bag
tikrit.MOHAMMED: tailored navy suit and white shirt

engagement.BRIDE: elegant modest blush-pink engagement gown with long sleeves and delicate gold embroidery, hair styled in soft waves
engagement.MOHAMMED: black tailored suit, white shirt, burgundy tie, small red rose boutonniere

wedding.BRIDE: modest white wedding gown with long lace sleeves and a light flowing veil
wedding.MOHAMMED: classic black tuxedo with a red rose boutonniere

shots.desc_ar: شاشة سوداء تظهر فيها ذرات ضوء صغيرة تتطاير ببطء
shots.prompt: Pure dark screen, tiny warm golden light particles slowly drift and float upward, soft bokeh, dreamy and quiet. Slow push-in.

shots.desc_ar: وردة حمراء واحدة في منتصف الشاشة، قطرات ندى لامعة على بتلاتها
shots.prompt: A single red rose centered in frame against a soft dark-to-warm gradient, glistening dew drops slide down its velvety petals, golden light particles around it. Very slow macro push-in toward the rose. Leave the upper third of the frame clean.

shots.desc_ar: الوردة تذوب وتتحول الخلفية إلى شارع عراقي هادئ بأجواء جامعية
shots.prompt: Match dissolve: the red rose softly blurs and the background blooms into a calm Iraqi street near a university, sand-colored buildings, palm trees, students in the distance, warm golden daylight. Slow crane down.

shots.desc_ar: سنتر القانون — البطلة وصديقتها المحجبة تمشيان وتحملان وروداً حمراء (لقطة من الخلف)
shots.prompt: Valentine's Day outside a busy law-studies tutoring center in Iraq. {BRIDE} walks beside {FRIEND}, both holding bouquets of red roses, chatting happily. Camera follows from behind at waist height, natural street life around them, soft golden daylight, her loose hair moving in the breeze. Leave the lower third clean.

shots.desc_ar: زاوية جانبية تكشف مرور محمد بالقرب منهما
shots.prompt: Camera arcs to a side angle beside the two girls, revealing {MOHAMMED} walking past them in the opposite direction, holding a sheet of paper in one hand. Golden daylight, shallow depth of field.

shots.desc_ar: محمد يلتفت بابتسامة عفوية ويطلب وردة ليتصور بها
shots.prompt: {MOHAMMED} stops, turns back toward the girls with a spontaneous friendly smile and gestures politely toward the red roses as if asking to borrow one for a photo, a sheet of paper in his other hand. Medium shot, warm light, light romantic-comedy mood.

shots.desc_ar: البطلة تلتفت باستغراب لطيف وابتسامة خجولة، والصديقة تبتسم
shots.prompt: {BRIDE} turns toward him with gentle surprise and a shy smile, long loose hair swaying; beside her {FRIEND} smiles warmly with amusement. Medium close-up, golden backlight.

shots.desc_ar: لقطة قريبة لليدين وهما تتبادلان الوردة الحمراء، خلفية ضبابية
shots.prompt: Extreme close-up of her hand offering a single red rose and his hand gently taking it, fingers not touching, soft glowing light, creamy bokeh background, slow motion. Anatomically correct hands, five fingers each.

shots.desc_ar: محمد يقف ليتصور بالوردة وفي يده الأخرى ورقة
shots.prompt: {MOHAMMED} stands posing for a photo holding the red rose in one hand and a sheet of paper in the other, playful proud smile, a soft camera-flash flare. In the background {BRIDE} with loose hair and {FRIEND} in her hijab watch and laugh. Medium wide shot.

shots.desc_ar: نظرة خجولة من البطلة، ابتسامة عابرة من محمد، ثم لقطة قصيرة للوردة
shots.prompt: Quick shot-reverse: {BRIDE} glances shyly and looks away tucking hair behind her ear; {MOHAMMED} gives a brief warm smile; end on a close-up of the red rose in his hand catching the sunlight.

shots.desc_ar: انتقال من الوردة إلى شاشة هاتف بواجهة خيالية: إشعار متابعة
shots.prompt: Transition from the red rose petals into an elegant anime-style smartphone screen held in a hand, a fictional minimal social app interface with a small heart-shaped follow notification icon glowing, no real logos, no readable names or text. Soft pink light.

shots.desc_ar: البطلة تنظر إلى الهاتف وتبتسم
shots.prompt: {BRIDE} sits by a window in the evening looking at her phone, a soft smile spreading on her face, screen glow on her cheeks, warm cozy room. Close-up.

shots.desc_ar: محمد يكتب رسالة على هاتفه
shots.prompt: {MOHAMMED} typing a message on his phone, a small hopeful smile, thumbs moving naturally, soft lamp light. Close-up on face then hands. Screen content not readable.

shots.desc_ar: لقطة للسماء عند الغروب
shots.prompt: Wide sunset sky over an Iraqi city, layered pink, orange and gold clouds, birds gliding, slow pan.

shots.desc_ar: ممرات الجامعة وضوء الشمس من النوافذ؛ محمد أمام القاعة يلوّح لها
shots.prompt: University corridor with tall windows, sunbeams and floating dust, notebooks and students. {MOHAMMED} stands in front of a lecture hall door and waves cheerfully to {BRIDE} as she approaches holding notebooks. Dolly forward.

shots.desc_ar: قبل الامتحان يراجع معها ويشير لنقطة مهمة؛ تكتم ضحكتها ويتبادلان نظرة صداقة
shots.prompt: Before an exam in the hallway, {MOHAMMED} quickly points to a key line in her study notes as a helpful tip; {BRIDE} tries to hold back a laugh, covering her mouth; they share a warm friendly glance. Light, wholesome, sunlight from windows.

shots.desc_ar: يمشيان معاً في مكان عام ويتحدثان
shots.prompt: {BRIDE} and {MOHAMMED} walk side by side through a pleasant public park promenade in Iraq, talking and smiling, a respectful distance, golden hour light, smooth tracking shot, soft bokeh.

shots.desc_ar: جلسة في مقهى هادئ وضحك
shots.prompt: A quiet cozy café, {BRIDE} and {MOHAMMED} sit across a small wooden table with two cups of tea, laughing together, steam rising, warm window light. A single red rose rests at the edge of the table near the frame edge.

shots.desc_ar: مونتاج لحظات ضحك وحديث، والوردة الحمراء في طرف الصورة كرمز
shots.prompt: Gentle montage feel: close-ups of {BRIDE} laughing and {MOHAMMED} listening with a warm smile, a red rose appearing softly blurred at the frame edge as a recurring symbol, slow drifting camera.

shots.desc_ar: تبادل النظرات عند الغروب، والألوان تهدأ تدريجياً نحو الأزرق
shots.prompt: {BRIDE} and {MOHAMMED} exchange a quiet glance at sunset by a low wall, the colors slowly shift from warm gold and pink to calmer muted blue tones, a hint of wistfulness. Slow push-in.

shots.desc_ar: يدها تغلق حقيبة السفر
shots.prompt: Close-up of {BRIDE}'s hand slowly zipping closed a travel suitcase on a bed, folded clothes, soft blue morning light, quiet melancholy. Then tilt up to her pensive face.

shots.desc_ar: البطلة قرب نافذة السيارة تنظر إلى الطريق بصمت
shots.prompt: {BRIDE} sits in the back seat of a car, head near the window, silently watching the Iraqi highway and desert landscape pass by, reflections on the glass, soft blue light with faint gold.

shots.desc_ar: بغداد عند الغروب: الجسور ونهر دجلة وانعكاس الأضواء على الماء
shots.prompt: Breathtaking wide aerial shot of Baghdad at sunset, the Tigris river winding through the city, bridges spanning the water, city lights beginning to glow and reflect on the river, calm blue sky with gold horizon. Slow aerial drift.

shots.desc_ar: البطلة في بغداد تنظر إلى هاتفها بحنين
shots.prompt: {BRIDE} on a Baghdad balcony at dusk looking at her phone with longing, city lights behind her, soft blue tones, a light breeze in her hair.

shots.desc_ar: محمد في مكان آخر يتأمل رسائلهما وصورهما
shots.prompt: {MOHAMMED} alone in his room at night, sitting by a window looking at old photos and messages on his phone, screen not readable, missing her, soft blue moonlight with a warm desk lamp.

shots.desc_ar: لقطة واسعة لجسر الأحرار عند الغروب، دجلة وأضواء المدينة
shots.prompt: Epic wide shot of Al-Ahrar Bridge in Baghdad at golden sunset, the Tigris river shimmering with golden reflections, city lights glowing, birds in the sky. Very slow cinematic push-in.

shots.desc_ar: البطلة قرب الجسر بعيون دامعة، تلتفت فجأة فترى محمداً قادماً
shots.prompt: {BRIDE} stands near the railing of Al-Ahrar Bridge, eyes filled with tears, then turns suddenly and sees {MOHAMMED} walking toward her. Close-up on her widening eyes, golden backlight, hair moving in the river breeze.

shots.desc_ar: الكاميرا بطيئة جداً، يتوقفان لحظة وكأن العالم سكت، تقترب بخطوات مترددة
shots.prompt: Extreme slow motion: {BRIDE} and {MOHAMMED} stop a few steps apart on the bridge as if the whole world went silent, a single tear rolls down her cheek, she steps toward him hesitantly. Background softly blurred, golden sunset.

shots.desc_ar: لقطة سينمائية قريبة لليدين وهما تتلامسان
shots.prompt: Cinematic close-up: {MOHAMMED}'s hand gently takes {BRIDE}'s hand, fingers softly interlacing, golden rim light, a few red rose petals drifting past. Anatomically correct hands, five fingers each.

shots.desc_ar: وجهها يبكي من التأثر ووجهه ينظر إليها بحنان، بتلات حمراء في الهواء
shots.prompt: Alternating close-ups: {BRIDE} crying from deep emotion with a trembling smile, {MOHAMMED} looking at her with tenderness; a few red rose petals float in the gentle breeze over the Tigris at sunset. Hold still at the moment their eyes meet. Leave the upper third clean.

shots.desc_ar: اليدان المتشابكتان تتحولان إلى خلفية ذهبية دافئة والوردة بينهما
shots.prompt: Their intertwined hands dissolve into a warm abstract golden background, a single red rose appears glowing between them, light particles swirl gently.

shots.desc_ar: الكاميرا تدور حولهما ثم ترتفع إلى سماء مليئة بالأضواء (مكان التاريخ)
shots.prompt: Camera slowly orbits {BRIDE} and {MOHAMMED} standing together, then tilts up into an evening sky full of tiny twinkling lights and soft stars, deep blue with gold glow. Leave the center of the sky clean for a title.

shots.desc_ar: يسيران معاً تحت أضواء المساء بطمأنينة وأمل
shots.prompt: {BRIDE} and {MOHAMMED} walk side by side under warm evening street lights in Baghdad, calm peaceful expressions full of hope, soft glow, tracking shot from behind then side.

shots.desc_ar: الطريق إلى تكريت ومناظر عراقية عند الغروب
shots.prompt: Wide shot of a highway heading north to Tikrit at sunset, Iraqi landscape with palm groves and the Tigris in the distance, warm golden light, a car moving along the road.

shots.desc_ar: البطلة تحمل حقيبتها وتنظر من النافذة بابتسامة هادئة
shots.prompt: {BRIDE} in the car holding her bag, looking out the window with a calm hopeful smile, golden sunset light across her face.

shots.desc_ar: محمد يرتب ملابسه الأنيقة استعداداً للتقدم رسمياً
shots.prompt: Close-up of {MOHAMMED}'s hands adjusting his tie and buttoning his suit jacket in front of a mirror, then his determined happy face, preparing to formally propose to her family. Warm interior light.

shots.desc_ar: وردة حمراء موضوعة على الطاولة ينظر إليها
shots.prompt: A single red rose lying on a wooden table in soft warm light, {MOHAMMED} in the background slightly out of focus looking at it with a smile. Rack focus.

shots.desc_ar: قاعة احتفالية راقية بالورود البيضاء والحمراء وأضواء ذهبية
shots.prompt: An elegant celebration hall decorated with white and red roses, crystal chandeliers and twinkling golden fairy lights, luxurious warm atmosphere. Slow dolly forward. Leave the center clean for a title.

shots.desc_ar: البطلة بفستان الخطوبة ومحمد ببدلته يتبادلان نظرات الفرح
shots.prompt: {BRIDE} and {MOHAMMED} stand facing each other, exchanging looks of joy and gratitude, golden bokeh lights behind them. Medium two-shot.

shots.desc_ar: لقطة قريبة لليدين أثناء وضع خاتم الخطوبة، ثم الابتسامتين
shots.prompt: Close-up of {MOHAMMED} gently sliding a delicate gold engagement ring onto {BRIDE}'s finger, soft sparkle, then tilt up to their two smiles. Anatomically correct hands, five fingers each.

shots.desc_ar: لقطة واسعة للأجواء الاحتفالية وبتلات تتساقط
shots.prompt: Wide shot revealing the festive hall, rose petals slowly falling around the couple from above, golden lights glittering, emotional climax. Leave the center of the frame clean for a title.

shots.desc_ar: الوردة الحمراء الأولى بين العروس والعريس بملابس الزفاف
shots.prompt: The same single red rose held between {BRIDE} and {MOHAMMED}, both in wedding attire, close framing on the rose with their smiling faces softly behind it.

shots.desc_ar: البتلات تتحول إلى أضواء ذهبية، ويمشيان نحو ضوء دافئ في ممر مزين بالورود
shots.prompt: The rose petals transform into floating golden lights; {BRIDE} and {MOHAMMED} walk hand in hand down an aisle lined with roses toward a warm glowing light at its end. Camera follows from behind.

shots.desc_ar: الكاميرا ترتفع لتكشف المشهد ثم تتلاشى إلى الكريمي والذهبي (مكان العبارة الختامية والأسماء)
shots.prompt: Camera stops behind the couple then slowly cranes up to reveal the whole rose-lined aisle, the image gently fades into a soft cream and gold glow with drifting light particles. Keep the frame calm and clean for closing titles and names.
